caption: The drawing depicts a sculpture of a sitting dog placed on a rectangular base. The dog is shown with its head raised and turned to the left, its mouth slightly open, and its tongue visible. The posture of the dog has its front right leg straight and its front left leg bent, while both rear legs are positioned as if the dog is resting on its haunches. The drawing is rendered in shades of gray and appears to be done with pencil or charcoal on light-colored paper, with visible shading indicating the texture and musculature of the dog, as well as the shadows cast by the figure. The rectangular base is also shaded to give it a three-dimensional appearance. The outline of the drawing is enclosed within a simple, thin, rectangular border. In the bottom left corner, there is a signature that reads "H. Bader."
title: Cast Lead Dog
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
